pages.text: A piece takes the worst star among its parts, and its stats come from its stars. A ★1 plate set is a little better than iron; ★3 is a little better than diamond; ★5 a little better than netherite.
pages.title: Stars on Gear

pages.text: With Apotheosis, stars go further: ★4 gear has a gem socket and ★5 two; ★6 and ★7 strengthen the attribute bonuses Apotheosis puts on them; and ★7 gear comes off the table already enchanted with an Apotheosis rarity.
pages.title: Apotheosis
